record.final_text:
I fixed both bugs, and all 4 tests in `tests/` pass.

1. **`LRU.get`** (`cachelib/lru.py`): a hit now moves the key to the most-recently-used position before returning the value. A missing key still returns `default`.
2. **`TTLCache.get`** (`cachelib/ttl.py`): `get` now compares the current clock time with the time the entry was stored. If at least `ttl` seconds have passed, it deletes the entry and returns `default`. The test `test_expired` expects an entry to be gone at exactly `ttl` seconds, so the boundary counts as expired.

Expired entries are only removed when you `get` them. Keys that are never read again stay in memory.

messages.content:
Two cache bugs in `cachelib`:

1. `LRU.get` doesn't count as a use, so recently read keys get evicted first.
2. `TTLCache` never expires anything. Entries should disappear `ttl` seconds after they were stored.

Please fix both. Tests are in `tests/` (they use a fake clock).

input.command: cd /work && find . -name "*.py" | grep -v test_ | head -20; cat cachelib/*.py; ls tests

cd /work && cat tests/test_ttl.py | head -40
python - <<'E'
import re
p='cachelib/lru.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("        return self.data.get(key, default)","        if key not in self.data:\n            return default\n        self.data.move_to_end(key)\n        return self.data[key]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='cachelib/ttl.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("value, _ = self.data[key]\n","value, stored = self.data[key]\n        if self.clock() - stored >= self.ttl:\n            del self.data[key]\n            return default\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15

from cachelib.ttl import TTLCache


def test_fresh():
    t = [0.0]
    c = TTLCache(ttl=10, clock=lambda: t[0])
    c.put("k", "v")
    t[0] = 9.9
    assert c.get("k") == "v"


def test_expired():
    t = [0.0]
    c = TTLCache(ttl=10, clock=lambda: t[0])
    c.put("k", "v")
    t[0] = 10.0
    assert c.get("k") is None

final_files.tests/test_lru.py:
from cachelib.lru import LRU


def test_get_refreshes():
    c = LRU(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("b", 2)
    c.get("a")
    c.put("c", 3)
    assert c.get("a") == 1 and c.get("b") is None


def test_missing():
    assert LRU(1).get("x", 5) == 5

from cachelib.ttl import TTLCache


def test_fresh():
    t = [0.0]
    c = TTLCache(ttl=10, clock=lambda: t[0])
    c.put("k", "v")
    t[0] = 9.9
    assert c.get("k") == "v"


def test_expired():
    t = [0.0]
    c = TTLCache(ttl=10, clock=lambda: t[0])
    c.put("k", "v")
